metadata.description: Multi-agent system shipping agentskills.io-spec runtime pipelines: music-video shorts production, a four-team content-shorts pipeline (research → production ⇄ legal → release) for info / news / real-artist (idol) shorts, and Korean job-board digest aggregation.  Local-first ($0 runtime), Claude for the research/legal judgment stages, three-layer reactive audit.

plugins.name: music-video
plugins.description: Generate a 60-second 9:16 vertical music video from an operator-supplied music file plus mood keywords.  Phrase-aware ffmpeg shaders sync vintage visuals to music structure; beat-aligned cuts via aubiotrack, onset-aligned glitch micro-edits via aubioonset, pond-ripple + halation post-shaders.  Music is the sole audio — no narration, no captions.

plugins.name: job-hunt
plugins.description: Aggregate job postings from Korean job boards (사람인 / 잡코리아 / 원티드 / 프로그래머스) matched against operator filters (직군 + 지역 + 키워드).  Produces a dated markdown digest plus apply-assist links.  Locale-extensible by design — currently kr only, PRs welcome for other locales.  All four kr-* source plugins ship in mock-fallback mode; live HTTP per-plugin flag-gated.

plugins.name: info-short
plugins.description: 정보쇼츠 — a 60-second 9:16 informational/explainer short produced through a four-team pipeline (research → production ⇄ legal → release).  Reuses the faceless-short render core; adds a sourced-research stage and a legal gate (license + accuracy + disclosure) before release.  Local-first ($0 default), manual upload only.

plugins.name: news-short
plugins.description: 뉴스쇼츠 — a 60-second 9:16 news-recap short through the same four-team pipeline, with a recency gate (newest source within N days), multi-source corroboration, an 'as of <date>' stamp, and a stricter legal gate (defamation / named-living-person / attribution).  Reuses the faceless-short render core.

plugins.name: idol-short
plugins.description: 아이돌/아티스트 콘텐츠 쇼츠 — a 60-second 9:16 short ABOUT a real idol/artist (subject-configurable via config/subjects/<id>.yaml).  Because the subject is real people + a trademarked group, the legal gate is load-bearing: it enforces a default-safe path (synthetic narration + sourced facts + license-clean generic B-roll + on-screen text; no member imagery / group audio / agency media) and adds idol-content checks (portrait-publicity-rights, media-rights-reuse, fan-content-disclaimer, defamation, minors).  Reuses the faceless-short render core.
